long_biography.plain_text:
After completing higher education in Switzerland, Fahad Hussein Alfardan took over Alfardan Exchange, a family company launched in 1971, and spent more than three decades expanding his finance career. He also founded Qatar Securities Company and served as its managing director for 15 years, while building leadership roles across Alfardan Investment and the wider family group.

Industrial services became a parallel track when he established Gulf Supplies and Commercial Services in 1996. He now chairs Al Mahhar Holding, which supplies equipment and services to Qatar’s energy and infrastructure sectors, and remains president of Alfardan Marine Services. That division sells boats and engines and provides servicing, electronics, parts and accessories.

uncertainties.detail: The subject is Fahad Hussein/Hussain Ibrahim Alfardan. Hussain Ibrahim Alfardan is the group chairman and earlier-generation founder; Ali Hussain Alfardan and Omar Hussain Alfardan hold separate senior group roles; Fardan Fahad Alfardan and Sara Fahad Alfardan are later-generation executives. None of their personal roles or achievements is attributed to Fahad in this dossier.
No suitable public primary or strong secondary source was located for Fahad Alfardan's exact birth date or place of birth. Those missing fields remain unproposed.

Public sources establish the required succession premises: the family platform predated his career, he succeeded into its leadership, and he is now an ultimate shareholder with continuing control and operating roles. That supports a medium-confidence family-transfer inference. The date, legal mechanism and value are not public, so no inheritance, gift, purchase or other precise route is claimed.

Listing materials identify Dibal Consultancy as Al Mahhar's dominant shareholder and Fahad Alfardan as one of Dibal's three owners. This supports substantial indirect ownership, but the dossier does not assume that every Dibal-held share is economically divided equally or value his interest.

Focused exact-name searches found company pages and posts about Fahad Alfardan but no securely attributable personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok or personal website. Only the official Alfardan Exchange company site is proposed.

Oil & gas is proposed because Al Mahhar is an energy-dominated operating group and Alfardan is both its current chair and an indirect substantial owner. Banking is not proposed because currency exchange is non-bank financial services, and Marine engineering is not proposed because the evidence establishes marine sales and servicing rather than a defining engineering mandate.

Short-term financial results, dividends, exact transaction values, private property, unrelated family details, litigation, allegations, controversy, political activity and all vessel-specific research are excluded from the biographies and classifications.
